mapper.insert: insert into chat_message (user_id, question, answer, time) values (#{userId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{time})
mapper.select: select c.id, c.user_id, u.name as user_name, c.question, c.answer, c.time from chat_message c left join `user` u on u.id = c.user_id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.id desc
select c.user_id, u.name as user_name, max(c.id) as message_id, max(c.time) as last_time from chat_message c left join `user` u on u.id = c.user_id group by c.user_id, u.name order by last_time desc
